The '''Bantha Plains''' were an expanse of land on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] located in the [[Northern Dune Sea/Legends|Northern Dune Sea]], north of the [[B'omarr Flats/Legends|B'omarr Flats]]. They were named after the [[Bantha/Legends|horned creature]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="ItWoSWT" />
